name: Text
statusNote: Alpha in name only: Text is an inline span with optional size, weight and white-space presets, stable across several majors.
summary: A run of body text with optional size (body small, medium, large), weight and white-space presets. Use it for copy and labels inside other layouts; use Heading for titles and Truncate to clip one line.

inputs.name: size
inputs.description: Body size and line height. With none, both are inherited.

inputs.name: weight
inputs.description: Font weight: 300, 400, 500 or 600. With none, inherited.

inputs.name: whiteSpace
inputs.description: How spaces and line breaks in the content are treated and whether lines wrap. With none, inherited.

inputs.name: element
inputs.description: The element rendered (the as prop): span by default, p or div for block text.

anatomy.name: Text
anatomy.description: An inline text run in the inherited colour and family.

variants.description: The CSS white-space value of the same name: pre keeps spaces and breaks and never wraps; nowrap collapses spaces and never wraps; pre-wrap keeps both and wraps; pre-line keeps breaks, collapses spaces and wraps; normal collapses both and wraps.

layout.text: A size sets font size and line height from separate body tokens (not the shorthand), so the family and weight stay inherited unless weight is also set.
The line-height tokens are unitless ratios: multiply by the font size (12 x 1.625 = 19.5px, 14 x 1.5 = 21px, 16 x 1.5 = 24px).
Each unset axis inherits from the surroundings; Text sets no colour, margin or display, so it flows inline as a span.
whiteSpace maps one to one onto CSS white-space.

states.text: Static text; Text has no interactive states and no colour of its own.

behaviour.text: Text renders the element named by as (span by default) with the size, weight and whiteSpace presets as data attributes; any other props pass through and can override them.

semantics: Exposed as plain text; the element passed as as (p, strong, em...) supplies any semantics.

notes.text: Every preset sits inside :where(), so it has zero specificity and any caller class overrides it. Unset presets inherit rather than default to body-medium: a bare Text inside a 12px parent is 12px.

Weight light (300) and medium (500) rely on the drawn font having those faces; a browser falls back to the nearest available weight. A native build drawing in a platform face should map each weight to a face that exists and accept the nearest one, as the browser does.

White-space handling (collapsing runs of spaces, honouring newlines, wrap or no wrap) is the browser's text engine. A native build must implement each of the five modes in its text layout: collapse whitespace for normal, nowrap and pre-line; keep newlines for pre, pre-wrap and pre-line; disable wrapping for pre and nowrap.
Inline text inherits colour from its container; Text sets none, so the default is the page's --fgColor-default under BaseStyles.
